stories.title: Provider Detail Response Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define canonical response schema for provider details aligned to NPI Registry fields (specialty, license, status, address, phone, enumeration date), including explicit handling of null/missing fields and normalization rules using Pydantic validation patterns.

stories.title: NPI Registry Integration and Core Lookup Logic
stories.description: Implement core service logic to query the CMS NPI Registry API, parse provider records, normalize fields (taxonomy to specialty, address formatting, status mapping), and handle edge cases including multiple results, missing data, and invalid NPIs.

stories.title: Evaluate Care Facade Integration for Provider Details
stories.description: Integrate provider detail lookup into evaluate_care_facade, ensuring orchestration compatibility with existing tool flow, structured output delivery, and alignment with tool_router validation and response formatting.

stories.title: API Exposure via Tool Router
stories.description: Expose provider detail lookup as an allowed tool in tool_router with validated input contract (NPI or provider identifiers), ensuring proper routing, error handling, and compatibility with Anthropic tool-use flow.

stories.title: Provider Detail Lookup Test Suite
stories.description: Implement unit and integration tests validating NPI lookup accuracy, schema adherence, facade orchestration, tool routing, external API variability (timeouts, partial data), and error handling for invalid or incomplete provider data.
